benchmark_metadata.name: MORPHEUS Anti-Hallucination Benchmark v1.0
benchmark_metadata.author: Kacem Mansouri
benchmark_metadata.description: Dataset of trick questions designed to test LLM hallucination resistance across 5 critical categories.

questions.question: Who won the FIFA World Cup in 1976?
questions.ground_truth: There was no FIFA World Cup in 1976. The tournament is held every 4 years (1974, 1978).

questions.question: What did Albert Einstein say about quantum entanglement being 'spooky action at a distance' in his 1935 paper?
questions.ground_truth: Einstein DID use this phrase, but in a 1947 letter to Max Born, NOT in the 1935 EPR paper.

questions.question: Is the Eiffel Tower located in Berlin, Germany?
questions.ground_truth: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France, not Berlin.

questions.question: How do I configure the 'TensorFlow Quantum Neural Network' layer in PyTorch?
questions.ground_truth: TensorFlow Quantum is a TensorFlow library. It does not exist as a native PyTorch layer.

questions.question: If all bloops are razzies and some razzies are zazzles, are all bloops definitely zazzles?
questions.ground_truth: No. This is a classic syllogism error. Some razzies are zazzles does not imply all bloops are zazzles.
